map.规范的 Markdown 更易渲染与维护。本工具扫描常见风格问题（如跳级标题、列: Consistent Markdown is easier to render and maintain. This tool scans for common style issues (such as skipped heading levels, list items missing a space, and empty links) and lists them one by one so you can fix them.
map.检查 Markdown 文档的规范与风格问题。: Check a Markdown document for consistency and style issues.
map.：标题层级是否跳级、列表缩进是否一致、行尾多余空格、代码块是否标注语言。: : skipped/duplicate headings, missing space after list markers, empty link URLs, trailing whitespace (MD009), lines over 80 chars (MD013), and fenced code blocks without a language (MD040); content inside fenced code blocks is excluded from heading and list checks.
map.：一级标题后直接跳三级、同一文档多个一级标题、链接与图片缺少说明。: : jumping straight from a level-1 to a level-3 heading, multiple level-1 headings in one document, and links or images missing alt text.
map.：可参考 markdownlint 的编号规则（如 MD013 行宽、MD041: : mapped to markdownlint rule numbers — MD001 heading levels, MD009 trailing spaces, MD013 line length and MD040 code-block language are implemented; MD007 list indentation and MD041 first-line heading are left to team conventions.
map.：统一文档风格，提升可读性与长期可维护性。: : unify document style for better readability and long-term maintainability.

map.标题建议从 H1 起逐层递增，跳级会影响文档大纲与 SEO 锚点。: Headings should start at H1 and increase one level at a time; skipping levels disrupts the document outline and SEO anchors.
map.无序列表 `-`/`*` 后需一个空格；有序列表 `1. ` 后也需空格，否则不: Unordered list markers `-`/`*` need a space after them; ordered list markers `1. ` need one too, otherwise the content is not rendered as a list.
map.本检查为风格辅助，不覆盖 CommonMark 全部语法；导出前仍建议用官方解析: This check is a style aid and does not cover the full CommonMark syntax; previewing with an official parser before export is still recommended.
map.检查 MD 风格与潜在问题。: Check Markdown style and potential issues.
map.给团队文档定规范：提交前跑一遍检查，把标题层级跳级、链接失效、行尾空格这些问题挡: Set conventions for team docs: run the check before committing and catch skipped heading levels, broken links and trailing whitespace before review.
map.标题层级跳级、列表缺空格等给出警告。: Flags skipped heading levels, list items missing a space, and more.
map.多数 linter 支持配置文件禁用规则。: Most linters support a config file to disable rules.
map.为什么它报的问题看起来不重要？: Why do the reported issues look unimportant?
map.因为 lint 检查的是「一致性与可维护性」而非「正确性」：行尾空格、标题前后空: Because lint checks consistency and maintainability rather than correctness: trailing whitespace, blank lines around headings and consistent list indentation do not affect rendering individually, but together they add noise to diffs and make collaboration harder to align. You can turn off some rules to match your team's habits, but keeping at least the structural rules is recommended.
map.按行扫描 Markdown：围栏代码块（``` / ~~~）内的行跳过标题、列表: Scans Markdown line by line: lines inside fenced code blocks (``` / ~~~) are skipped for heading, list, trailing-space and line-length checks, and an opening fence without a language is flagged as MD040; a heading line starting with one to six hashes plus a space records its level, a jump of more than one level over the previous heading is flagged, and repeated heading text is flagged as a duplicate; a line that starts (after optional leading whitespace) with a hyphen or asterisk immediately followed by a non-space character is flagged as a missing space after the list marker, unless the whole line is a paired emphasis span (*italic* / **bold** / _italic_); each line is matched against bracket link syntax and an empty target is flagged as an empty link URL; trailing whitespace is MD009 and a line longer than 80 characters is MD013. It outputs the total line count and issue count, then lists each issue line number and description
